easyPrerequisites: You haven't created any tokens this turn.
description:
Declare Emissary Green as an attacker, triggering its ability. Choose to vote for "Profit", creating at least four token copies of Biovisionary due to Esix and Chatterfang.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers.
Resolve the first Biovisionary trigger, causing you to win the game.
